limitations: Single inherited-model session; resolved backend identity, native tokens, cost and context pressure unavailable. Shared-host scheduling is not a timing comparison. No child was used in the main-only condition. Ordered image inspection does not establish continuous playback. Header occlusion is retained for independent review.
